messages:
marta_cs: FYI Everwell Health reached out requesting onboarding of a bespoke 14B summarizer for discharge notes. Key constraints: PHI-aware redaction, key wrapping via HSM, audit logs for redaction events, and SOC2 evidence. They want p95 <=200ms and expect 60 qps steady with 180 qps short bursts. Renewal in 10 business days so this could sway renewal.
owen_se: Thanks. Do they need Private (VPC) deployment or an on-prem appliance? HSM suggests Private. Also need their prompt bank + an eval set with labeled PHI to validate redaction.
marta_cs: Customer wrote: "We require private deployment, HSM-backed keys, per-record redaction audit trail, SOC2 type II report, canary rollout, and rollback within 15 minutes. Expected traffic: 60 qps steady, peaks to 180 qps."
ravi_infra: Recommending Private with dedicated pool. Preliminary sizing: 5xA10G (quantized 14B) + KV cache and autoscale policy for bursts; HSM provisioning lead time ~7 business days. I'll run a performance spike sim and cost delta.
deploy-bot: deploy ticket created: DR-9451. CI and security checks queued. https://deploys.internal/DR-9451
nora_pm: We must run a safety/regression suite focused on redaction escape cases and medical hallucinations. @marta_cs can you secure a labeled eval set and sample prompts by EOD Thu? Also capture any SLA wording they want included for the renewal.
owen_se: Draft eval plan: 1) redaction recall/precision per entity (MRN, DOB, meds), 2) hallucination regression vs baseline on clinical Q&A, 3) throughput and p95 under sustained 3-min bursts. Quick harness prototype: ```python
for p in eval_prompts:
    out = client.generate(model="everwell-14b-v1", prompt=p)
    log_redaction_events(out)
```
marta_cs: I'll request the labeled eval set, their SOC2 snapshot, and preferred SLA language. Also scheduling an enablement demo at their request.
ravi_infra: I'll post infra sizing, HSM provisioning plan, and estimated bill-of-materials by tomorrow 9am.
nora_pm: Capture renewal risk: mark account health as "elevated" until onboarding completes and post-enablement CSAT >=4. If any redaction failures appear in ops, escalation to AM.
marta_cs: Action owners: Eval set + prompts (marta_cs), infra & HSM plan (ravi_infra), safety harness (owen_se), enablement scheduling & renewal (nora_pm). Kicking off internal security review after we get their SOC2.
nora_pm: Putting a 30-min kickoff on calendar Mon 10am PT. Inviting Everwell security lead + our security reviewer and AM.
marta_cs: Noted. I'll update the account health page and flag renewal owner. :white_check_mark:
